dataList.data: Dictionaries are unordered collections of key-value pairs. They are mutable and allow fast lookups by key.

person = {'name': 'John', 'age': 30}

# Access values
print(person['name'])  # John
print(person.get('age'))  # 30

# Add/modify items
person['city'] = 'Boston'
person['age'] = 31

# Remove items
del person['age']
age = person.pop('name')

person = {'name': 'John', 'age': 30, 'city': 'NYC'}

print(person.keys())    # dict_keys(['name', 'age', 'city'])
print(person.values())  # dict_values(['John', 30, 'NYC'])
print(person.items())   # dict_items([('name', 'John'), ('age', 30), ('city', 'NYC')])

# Check if key exists
if 'name' in person:
    print('Name exists')
